integrity: Kinetic identities and some moment values are acknowledged as prior results. New theorem is stationary convex-order comparison and sharp Laplace strictness. Originality assessment is best-knowledge, not independent priority certification.
scientific_limitations: Only continuous-mass, well-mixed mean-field stationary laws of finite second moment at constant coagulation and fragmentation rates; binary split ratios strictly between zero and one. Comparisons require symmetrized split fractions comparable in convex order. No physical-time convergence or finite-particle conclusion.
title: Convex-order monotonicity of stationary cluster mass under dispersed binary splitting
